<details>
<summary>`abandonPendingCycle(uint256)`</summary>

The recovery for a subscription that was deleted, drained, or dropped this contract as a consumer while a request was in flight. Without it `pendingCycleId` never clears, every later `checkpoint` reverts `PendingRandomness`, and the reserved pot is stranded. A callback that arrives afterward is rejected by `fulfillRandomness`'s `pendingCycleId != cycleId` check, so the pot cannot be paid twice.Both legs are anchored on values no caller can move: `firstRequestedAt` is written once and `cycleEnd` is fixed. `requestedAt` is not usable here because `retryRandomness` is permissionless and rewrites it, so a gate keyed to it can be held shut by one retry per `vrfRetryDelay`.

</details>

| `ABANDON_AFTER()` | Time after a cycle ends before `abandonPendingCycle` opens to anyone. Seven days is `_validateConfig`'s ceiling on `vrfRetryDelay`, so at least one full retry interval fits inside it under every valid configuration. Measured from `cycleEnd`, which is fixed: `cycle.requestedAt` moves on every `retryRandomness`, and that call is permissionless, so a deadline keyed to it could be pushed back indefinitely. |
